paragraphs: AI: "Nuclear war and malicious use of AI threaten end of humanity by 2100, says Lancet assessment" (The Guardian) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Better Artificial Intelligence Stock: Arm vs. Marvell Technology" (The Motley Fool).

Political: "Nine people, including children, dead after mass shooting in Pennsylvania" (The Guardian) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Justice Dept. Is Investigating TV Networks Over Trump Pool Coverage" (The New York Times).

Economic: "US CPI to Show Overall Inflation Boosted by Higher Gasoline Prices" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "GOP Rep. Buddy Carter: 'Tariffs Are Part of the Issue' with Rising Prices" (Breitbart).
Financial: "Print Edition | Wall Street Journal" (WSJ) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Porsche Deliveries Fell 16% in First Nine Months of Year" (WSJ).

Geopolitical: "Saudi Arabia’s Riyadh Airport Attacked Again, After Days of Houthi Strikes" (The New York Times) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Pentagon Again Increases Number of U.S. Casualties in Iran War" (The New York Times).
